name: kapelle
description: Progressive human-controlled SDLC harness with a high-level feature map, system design, and approved vertical-slice delivery.

interface.longDescription: A progressive human-controlled SDLC harness that maps known feature behavior and system boundaries at high level, implements one production-shaped walking skeleton, details use cases and domain behavior just in time, writes unit tests at the end, and completes one risk-based verification pass.
defaultPrompt: Start a new feature from my raw task with Kapelle.
Map a feature specification and high-level system design with Kapelle.
Create a production-shaped walking skeleton with Kapelle.
Add the next business or technical requirement as a vertical slice.
Write final unit tests and verify a feature with Kapelle.
Show or recover a feature status with Kapelle.
Amend an in-progress feature safely with Kapelle.
Migrate an older Kapelle feature to the current workflow.
Reconstruct an existing feature's product behavior and as-built architecture from code evidence.
